selection: H49 applies the frozen Round 29 mechanism to every preregistered reserved identity. Each trajectory supplies its own model-only baseline.
treatment: At every validated terminal response, union at most six receipt-bound pinned-base observations overlapping actual changed ranges. No closure bytes are sent to the model.

branch_order.method: ascending frozen identity order; two repetitions per eligible shared prefix

input_unavailable_policy: Account both repetitions as fixed zero with no tokenizer or model dispatch.
stopping_rules: Confirmation outcomes may decide acceptance but may not tune a replacement confirmation run.
Every reserved identity and repetition is dispatched at most once; missing and failed rows remain zero.
No task, threshold, scorer, cap, source, closure policy, or identity changes after freeze.
claim_ceiling: Untouched GLM-5.3-flash 8K confirmation only; full 1,136-identity evaluation and larger windows remain required.
